# `/source-subtypes` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /source-subtypes/v1/machine-account-create-access

`getMachineAccountCreateAccessInfoV1` — Machine Account Create Access — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint retrieves the list of sources and subtypes for which logged in user has the entitlement to create a machine account. The response includes a list of object detailing the source, subtype and entitlement details which enables the clients to understand if they can submit the request to create a machine account for the given subtype.

- User levels: USER, API
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset Integer specifying the offset of the first result from the beginning of the collection. The standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Limit Integer specifying the maximum number of records to return in a single API call. The standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of machineaccountcreateaccessdto

### GET /source-subtypes/v1/{subtypeId}/machine-config

`getMachineAccountSubtypeApprovalConfigV1` — Machine Subtype Approval Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This endpoint retrieves the approval configuration for machine account creation and deletion at the machine subtype level. By providing a specific subtypeId in the path, clients can fetch the approval rules and settings (such as required approvers and comments policy) that govern account creation and deletion for that particular machine subtype. The response includes a MachineAccountSubtypeConfigDto object detailing these configurations, enabling clients to understand or display the approval…

- Scopes: idn:source-subtypes:management, idn:source-subtypes:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `subtypeId` (path, required) — machine subtype id.
- Returns 200: machineaccountsubtypeconfigdto

### PATCH /source-subtypes/v1/{subtypeId}/machine-config

`updateMachineAccountSubtypeApprovalConfigV1` — Machine Subtype Approval Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Updates the approval configuration for machine account deletion at the specified machine subtype level. This endpoint allows clients to modify approval rules and settings (such as required approvers and comments policy) for account creation and deletion workflows associated with a given subtypeId. Use this to customize or enforce approval requirements for creating and deleting machine accounts of a particular subtype.

- Scopes: idn:source-subtypes:delete, idn:source-subtypes:management, idn:source-subtypes:update
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `subtypeId` (path, required) — machine account subtype ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: machineaccountsubtypeconfigdto

### GET /source-subtypes/v2

`listSourceSubtypesV2` — List subtypes — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

List machine account subtypes defined at the source tier and the connector tier. Without `sourceId`, the API lists every subtype in the tenant, and `filters` and `sorters` apply. With `sourceId`, the API returns the source's effective subtypes: the subtypes defined for the source plus the subtypes defined for the source's connector type. When a source subtype has the same technical name as a connector subtype, only the source subtype is returned and its `origin` is `CONNECTOR`. `filters`…

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage, idn:sources:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `sourceId` (query) — ID of a source. When supplied, the API returns subtypes for that source instead of the whole tenant.
  - `effectiveSet` (query) — default True — Controls what is returned for `sourceId`. When `true`, which is the default when `sourceId` is supplied, the API returns the source's effective subtypes across both tiers. When `false`, the API…
  - `targetType` (query) — one of SOURCE, CONNECTOR — Returns only effective subtypes of this tier. Requires `sourceId`, and cannot be combined with `effectiveSet=false`; otherwise the API returns `400`.
  - `includeConfigs` (query) — default False — When `true`, each item includes a summary of its machine account creation configuration in `config`.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, ne, in; technicalName: eq, ne, in, sw, co; displayName: eq, ne, in, sw, co; source.id: eq, ne, in, sw, co; targetType: eq, ne, in, sw, co; targetId: eq, ne, in, sw, co; targetName: eq, ne, in, sw, co, isnull; classification: eq, ne, in, sw, co; type: eq, ne, in, sw, co; created: gt, ge, lt, le; modified: gt, ge, lt, le — e.g. `targetType eq "CONNECTOR"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, technicalName, displayName, source.id, targetType, targetId, targetName, classification, type, created, modified — e.g. `displayName`
- Returns 200: array of sourcesubtypev2withconfig

### POST /source-subtypes/v2

`createSourceSubtypeV2` — Create subtype — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Create a machine account subtype at the source tier or the connector tier. A `SOURCE` subtype applies to the one source identified by `targetId`. A `CONNECTOR` subtype applies to every source of the connector type identified by `targetId`, which must be a registered connector type. `targetType` defaults to `SOURCE`. `CONNECTOR_VARIANT` is not supported and returns `400`. `technicalName`, `displayName` and `description` are required, and the technical name and display name must be unique within…

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): createsourcesubtypev2request
- Returns 201: sourcesubtypev2

### GET /source-subtypes/v2/targets

`listSourceSubtypeTargetsV2` — List subtype targets — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

List the targets that have machine account subtypes, with subtype and source counts for each. A `targetType` filter is required. `targetType eq "CONNECTOR"` returns one item per connector type. `targetType eq "SOURCE"` returns one item per source subtype. A missing or unsupported `targetType` filter returns `400`. The caller needs the `idn:source-subtypes:read` right. This API returns `404` when Machine Identity Security or tiered subtype configuration is not enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage, idn:sources:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query, required) — fields: targetType: eq; targetName: eq, sw — e.g. `targetType eq "CONNECTOR"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: targetType, targetName, subtypeCount, sourceCount Results are sorted by targetName ascending by default. — e.g. `-subtypeCount`
- Returns 200: array of subtypetargetsummary

### GET /source-subtypes/v2/{id}

`getSourceSubtypeByIdV2` — Get subtype by ID — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Get a machine account subtype of any tier by subtype ID. The response may include `target.supportsProvisioning`. The caller needs the `idn:source-subtypes:read` right. A malformed ID returns `400`. This API returns `404` when Machine Identity Security or tiered subtype configuration is not enabled for the tenant.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the subtype.
- Returns 200: sourcesubtypev2

### PATCH /source-subtypes/v2/{id}

`patchMachineAccountSubtypeV2` — Patch subtype by ID — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Update a machine account subtype of any tier by subtype ID, using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard. Only `displayName` and `description` are patchable, and both must remain present. Changing `targetType`, `targetId`, `profile`, `classification`, `type` or `technicalName` returns `400`; to move a subtype to another tier or target, delete it and create a new one. Who can call this API depends on the tier of the stored subtype: * `SOURCE`: requires the…

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the subtype.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: sourcesubtypev2

### DELETE /source-subtypes/v2/{id}

`deleteMachineAccountSubtypeV2` — Delete subtype by ID — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Delete a machine account subtype of any tier by subtype ID. System-managed subtypes, and subtypes still assigned to accounts, cannot be deleted and the request is rejected. Who can call this API depends on the tier of the stored subtype: * `SOURCE`: requires the `idn:source-subtypes:delete` right, held by org admins, source admins and source sub-admins. * `CONNECTOR`: requires the `idn:connector-subtypes:delete` right, held by org admins. A caller without the right for the subtype's tier…

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the subtype.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /source-subtypes/v2/{id}/overrides

`createSourceSubtypeOverrideV2` — Override source connector subtype — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Create a source subtype that overrides a connector subtype on one source. The new source subtype copies the connector subtype's machine account configuration and provisioning policy at the time of the request. Later changes to the connector subtype are not applied to the override. The subtype identified by `id` must be a `CONNECTOR` subtype (otherwise `400`) that is in the source's effective subtypes. An unknown subtype or source returns `404`. The request is rejected if the tenant's subtype…

- Scopes: idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the connector subtype to override.
- Body (application/json): sourcesubtypeoverriderequest
- Returns 201: sourcesubtypev2

### GET /source-subtypes/v2/{id}/provisioning-policy

`getSourceSubtypeProvisioningPolicyV2` — Get subtype provisioning policy — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Get the machine account creation provisioning policy of a subtype of any tier. Returns `404` when the subtype has no provisioning policy. The caller needs the `idn:source-subtypes:read` right. A malformed ID returns `400`. This API returns `404` when Machine Identity Security or tiered subtype configuration is not enabled for the tenant.

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage, idn:sources:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the subtype.
  - `sourceId` (query) — ID of the source the subtype belongs to. Supply it for `SOURCE` subtypes so that a policy stored with the source can be found.
- Returns 200: subtypeprovisioningpolicy

### POST /source-subtypes/v2/{id}/provisioning-policy

`createSourceSubtypeProvisioningPolicyV2` — Create subtype provisioning policy — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Create the machine account creation provisioning policy of a subtype of any tier. A subtype has at most one provisioning policy; the request is rejected if one already exists. `id` and `subtypeId` must not be supplied (otherwise `400`). `usageType` must be `CREATE_MACHINE_ACCOUNT` or omitted. `name` defaults to the subtype's display name. Who can call this API depends on the tier of the subtype: * `SOURCE`: requires the `idn:source-subtypes:update` right, held by org admins, source admins and…

- Scopes: idn:connector-subtypes:manage, idn:sources:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the subtype.
  - `useDefaultFields` (query) — default True — When `true` and the request body has no `fields`, a `CONNECTOR` subtype's policy is created with the connector's default account creation fields. Ignored for `SOURCE` subtypes.
- Body (application/json): subtypeprovisioningpolicy
- Returns 201: subtypeprovisioningpolicy
